pages.text: The Redstone Clock switches states every 18 game ticks and pulses adjacent redstone. Place a comparator against it to read signal strength 15 or 0. The clock saves its current phase.

pages.name: Read the Clock
pages.text: Point the comparator so its rear touches the clock. Run redstone dust from the output.

pages.title: On and Off States
pages.text: The off-state block is part of the same clock and is also exposed in Creative. The placed clock alternates either way. In Signal mode a fuel generator can use this pulse to pause and resume its burn.
